attributes.notes: This replaces the previously approved 1.8.0 build 8 with build 10. The update stabilizes star-name labels while panning, slightly reduces their size, smooths Follow Device camera motion, and uppercases constellation names. To access the 3D view, open a station forecast, select a pass, and tap Planetarium (3D on narrow layouts). Follow Device is the arrow button at the top right; dragging returns to manual control.
